entries.title: Paging keys keep working after you use something inside a card
entries.body: With keys that work when you are not typing, such as Vim's Shift+H and Shift+L, paging from a link, button or checkbox inside a card, or from a button you clicked, now lands on the next card. Pressing the key again pages again instead of typing into the message box.
entries.noPicture: The fix is where focus goes after a key is pressed, which a still picture cannot show.
